g.text: Federation splits by feature. Sharding splits by row.
Different schemas, different load shapes, different teams.
Each can be tuned — or replaced — on its own.
Same schema everywhere. Only the rows differ.
Foreign keys between domains stop being enforced.
Federation is usually the cheaper first move: fewer pieces,
reversible, and it maps onto team boundaries.
Shard when one domain alone outgrows a machine.
